calibration.rationale: T4 empirical perturbation scale; not a significance guarantee. Use T4 warmup=100/repeat=2000 for each arm and workload; never divide the threshold by repeat or token count.

limitations: T4 is an empirical reference, not statistical significance. Two sequential counterbalanced orders in one process; thermal/frequency/scheduling drift remains. Tracemalloc perturbs allocations, misses some native allocations; RSS is process lifetime high-water mark. No bundled optimizations or per-token threshold rescaling. QKV verdict evaluates splitting; reverse its interpretation for merging. Decode is teacher-forced, excludes prefill, EOS and rollover. Scratch warm allocation is excluded; layout packing is included.
